written_by_evidence: components/quality-checks/rule.py files one record per ruling, through platform/tools/dispatch_card.py write_record — HE-1 (fact rulings), 2026-10-01
title: Fact rulings — a person's ruling on a held problem, by problem id
note: One record per ruling on one delivery problem of one brand. The latest ruling per (brand, problem id) stands; a later wrong revokes an earlier true. true and not-ours clear that id for every email of the brand; true-once clears it for its own email only; fill clears nothing at the gate and carries its fact text into the verified facts; wrong clears nothing — the email stays held until its text changes. The brand's verified facts are a read over these records (standing true + fill), never a second store and never brands/. Prices are never ruled — offer bank only.

verdict_fields.note: the brand the ruling belongs to, from the email's run.json — never read for another brand
the problem's id: first 12 hex of sha256 over gate, kind, quote
the email's run folder name (its label) the ruling was made on
the problem's kind: fact, chop, typo or unfilled
the email's words the problem quoted
what the brand's files said, when the check named it
the fact text, for true and fill — never a price
